fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal elections and city finances, including criticism of public-utility franchises and the Florida Power & Light arrangement; discussion of prohibition enforcement and bootlegging practices; local business and consumer-price commentary (milk and food prices) and a lengthy letter on apartment-house economics and rents; community and civic news including an American Legion drum and bugle corps competition report; transportation and tourism notices including Seaboard Air Line Railway excursion advertising; and local entertainment and sports listings (boxing card and theater program).
